checks.scenario: one SKU balance shared across catalog and warehouse
order entry reserves stock without reducing on hand
overselling, decimal quantity, duplicate PO and wrong programs reject atomically
credit guardrails apply to firm and bulk orders
hold-to-redemption transfers allocation without deducting stock
pick generates packing and dispatch reduces stock exactly once
vendor receipt is idempotent across vendor and warehouse modules
WMS putaway updates the linked supplier PO
partial bin transfers preserve totals and reject reserved stock
3PL routes link customer orders, reserve remote stock and dispatch once
dropship procurement and dispatch never increase warehouse stock
US, EU and Canada report imports preserve regional SKU identity
stale page writes reject rather than overwrite newer records
existing browser records migrate without changing IDs
multiline picking and packing preserve each SKU and partial order status
partial receipt creates follow-up receiving for the remaining quantity
damaged receiving posts physical stock while excluding damaged units from availability
event planning is saved in the shared workspace
malformed backups reject before replacing the workspace
cancelled 3PL orders release partner allocations and block further dispatch
digital orders dispatch linked masked references and release allocations
cloud adapter saves with optimistic revisions
cloud conflict pauses synchronization and preserves local records
